**What was wrong:** the original markup had no `<x-timer>` element at all — the script was calling `document.querySelector('x-timer')` on nothing, so `tick()` returned early and nothing counted down. The Start button toggled a JS flag and started an `every(1000)` interval, but the interval had nothing to read from.
